name: custos-eth-usd-market
description: Graded against the running app with no wallet and no credentials. Adding a market is configuration, so the app must be exactly as healthy as before: the keeper, trade and pool pages still read the live HBAR-USD deployment. The new market's feeds are proven on testnet by the chainValidation deploy hook before grading.

assertions.statement: The keeper page shows the network keeping the market: the next check, the gas held up front per run, and whether the reserve can pay the next run.
howToVerify: Wait up to 30 seconds for live data to load.
Confirm the page shows 'Next check' (or 'Next check in' with a countdown, or 'Due now').
Confirm the labels 'Held up front per run' and 'Can pay next run' are visible with values next to them (match without regard to letter case: some labels are styled in capitals).

assertions.statement: The trade page still prices HBAR-USD from the live feeds and offers both ways in: USDC and HBAR via SaucerSwap.
howToVerify: Confirm a mark price is shown (with no wallet the header reads 'HBAR-USD mark price'; match without regard to letter case) and the Chainlink feed is named on the page.
Confirm an option labelled 'HBAR via SaucerSwap' is offered for collateral.
Confirm a 'Liquidation price' figure appears once a collateral amount is entered (enter 5).

assertions.statement: The pool page shows the pool's money split between what backs open positions and what is free to withdraw.
howToVerify: Wait up to 30 seconds for live data.
Confirm the labels 'Backing open positions' and 'Free to withdraw' are visible with USDC values.

assertions.statement: The debug page lists the deployed contracts, so the ABIs the app was built with still match.
howToVerify: Confirm tabs or entries for 'PerpMarket', 'LiquidityPool' and 'PriceGuard' are present.
Open PerpMarket and confirm read functions such as 'nextRunAt' and 'runsLeft' are listed.
